newsitem.title: FRANCE: Groupe Andre to cut 400 jobs - paper.
newsitem.headline: Groupe Andre to cut 400 jobs - paper.

text.p: Retailer Groupe Andre is preparing to close 81 shoe stores and lay off around 400 people, the newspaper La Tribune said on Friday.
It said 326 job cuts would result from the closures and 79 from restructuring moves elsewhere in the group.
Officials at Groupe Andre, which employs 13,000 people in 2,400 stores, were not immediately available for comment.

The newspaper said Groupe Andre would announce the measures at staff council meetings next week. It has been undergoing a restructuring and reported a 64 million franc profit for the 1996/97 first half, compared with a loss of 12 million a year earlier.
